evals.expected_output: Notification with deadline and time zone and the no-payment line, verification and address request with a privacy line, delivery update, announcement with consent, non-winner message, in send order with channels and timing, plus a contact log format. assertions: Notification includes the deadline with time zone
States no payment or card details will be requested
Address request has a privacy and deletion line
